start.title: The Plain of Shinar
start.text:
A wide green plain stretches ahead.
All mankind has gathered here — one people, one tongue.

choices.text: Settle and build a home
choices.feedback: You sink roots into the earth. It feels right.

choices.text: Dream of something greater
choices.feedback: Genesis 11:2 — The people settled in the plain of Shinar and dreamed of greatness.

unity.title: One Tongue
unity.text:
Voices blend. Laughter rises.
There is no word you cannot understand.

choices.text: Praise God for the gift of unity
choices.feedback: You lift your voice in thanks. Others bow their heads.

choices.text: Boast of what we could achieve
choices.feedback: Genesis 11:4 — They said, 'Let us make a name for ourselves.'

choices.text: Stay silent — listen to the elders
choices.feedback: Wise voices speak softly. Others shout louder.

proposal.title: The Great Idea
proposal.text:
An elder rises. "Let us build a tower — its top in the heavens."
"Let us make a name for ourselves."

choices.text: Cheer — join the great work
choices.feedback: Genesis 11:3-4 — The people joined together to build a city and a great tower.

choices.text: Speak against it — this is pride
choices.feedback: Few hear you. But the words are spoken.

choices.text: Wait — let others decide
choices.feedback: Silence is its own answer. The vote passes.

bricks.title: Bricks and Tar
bricks.text:
You mold wet clay into bricks.
They are stronger than stone. They will reach the sky.

choices.text: Work for the love of craft
choices.feedback: Genesis 11:3 — They made bricks and used tar for mortar to build the tower.

choices.text: Race the others — outshine them
choices.feedback: Your speed turns to recklessness. Bricks crack.

construction.title: The First Floors
construction.text:
Walls rise. The tower casts a long shadow.
Men sing as they lift each beam.

choices.text: Boast — "We need no God now"
choices.feedback: Genesis 11:4 — They boasted, seeking a tower with its top reaching the heavens.

choices.text: Work quietly — say a prayer
choices.feedback: No one hears. But the prayer is heard above.

rising.title: Higher
rising.text:
Year after year. Stone upon stone.
The tower pierces the clouds.

choices.text: Doubt — should we stop?
choices.feedback: You whisper it. The wind carries the words away.

choices.text: Climb higher — there is no limit
choices.feedback: Genesis 11:4-5 — The tower rose higher in pride until the Lord came down to see it.

choices.text: Demand the workers go faster
choices.feedback: Tempers fray. Hands bleed. The tower climbs.

summit.title: Touching the Sky
summit.text:
You stand at the top. The earth is small below.
The heavens feel close — almost within reach.

choices.text: Reach upward — claim the sky
choices.feedback: Genesis 11:4 — Their pride reached upward, seeking to make a name for themselves.

choices.text: Kneel — feel suddenly small
choices.feedback: The vastness above swallows your pride.

gods_gaze.title: He Comes Down
gods_gaze.text:
A voice fills the air, calm as thunder.
"They are one people. Nothing will be impossible for them."

choices.text: Stand defiant before the voice
choices.feedback: Genesis 11:6-7 — God saw their pride and chose to confuse their language.

choices.text: Bow your head in fear and awe
choices.feedback: Your knees buckle. The presence is everywhere.

confusion.title: Strange Words
confusion.text:
You shout to your friend. He stares.
His mouth opens — but the sounds make no sense.

choices.text: Force him to understand — shout louder
choices.feedback: Anger only deepens the void between you.

choices.text: Step back — accept what God has done
choices.feedback: Genesis 11:7 — God confused their language so they could not understand one another.

choices.text: Blame the elders — start a fight
choices.feedback: Fists fly. The tower bleeds men instead of mortar.

scattering.title: Going Out
scattering.text:
Families gather what they can.
Each group walks toward a different horizon.

choices.text: Curse the heavens as you leave
choices.feedback: Bitterness is a heavy load to carry.

choices.text: Walk in silence, lesson in heart
choices.feedback: Genesis 11:8 — The Lord scattered the people from there over all the earth.

reflection.title: A New Land
reflection.text:
You stop on a quiet ridge.
The tower is far behind — a memory of pride.
